sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: Ostrya rehderiana is a deciduous tree endemic to Mount Tianmu in Zhejiang, China. Flora of China gives a height of up to about 15 m; other references report up to 20 m. The species is critically threatened.

sections.title: Leaves and fruit
sections.text: The doubly toothed leaves are about 3–10 × 1.8–4 cm and have 13–16 pairs of veins. The small nuts, 7–10 mm long, are enclosed by inflated papery bracts.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No food use was documented in the sources consulted.
